board_area.method: sum of the vendored KiCad 10.0.7 F.CrtYd courtyards (bbox; polygon area for a single fp_poly) of the bare board parts of pcb/generated/components.csv (DNP excluded) per board domain; need = modules (mount pcb_module) x 1.0 + other parts x fill factor 1.5 or 1.8 (1.8 = planning value) — MODEL ESTIMATE, not a placement
board_area.status: MODEL ESTIMATE: reported, not gated (OPEN = need at the planning factor exceeds the outline; the real placement decides)

with_harness.method: header courtyard w x d (vendored KiCad 10.0.7 footprint where that pin count exists, else parts.json harness_headers) x fill factor 1.5 or 1.8, added to the parts need; frontage = sum of header widths against the edge zones of boards.json (every header at an edge, cable leaving sideways); Mini-Fit Jr., IDC and FAN3 courtyards are assumptions (parts.json)
